steps.title: Apply with your admission
steps.text: Some university scholarships are decided with your admission; others need a separate form.

faq.q: Can a scholarship cover the full cost?
faq.a: A few government scholarships cover fees and living costs. Most university scholarships cover part of the tuition. Plan for the rest with savings or a loan.
As early as possible. Many scholarship deadlines are six to twelve months before the course starts.
